description: This PHP source file defines a trait named EntityManagerHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a set of helper methods for interacting with Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, such as fetching repositories, persisting and removing entities, creating query builders, and managing transactions. It is intended to be used as a reusable component to simplify ORM operations within the project.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the repository for a given entity class, typed as ObjectRepository or EntityRepository.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists an entity and flushes the EntityManager.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity and flushes the EntityManager.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a Doctrine QueryBuilder for a specified entity class with optional alias and index.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object wrapping the provided QueryBuilder.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a QueryBuilderWrapper object.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Executes a query to fetch a single result at a specified offset.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to an entity by class name and identifier.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
